summary: Bald Mountain above Ketchum has carried a lookout since 1921; the current frame cab dates to 1958, and fire watching ended in the mid-1990s.

facts.design: Frame cab on a concrete base
facts.agency: US Forest Service - Sawtooth National Forest

events.note: First lookout on the summit, a wooden structure.
L-4 cabin on a stone base, per the register. The Forest lookouts history instead dates new construction to 1940-41.
New building completed after CCC work began in June 1940, per the Forest lookouts history.
Bob Hewitt stationed at the lookout for the fire season, per a 1946 newspaper item.
Mr. and Mrs. Sluder listed as watchers.
Mr. and Mrs. Arnold Zenk listed as watchers; both were local teachers.
Current frame cab on a concrete base.
Fred Judd listed as a watcher.
Staffing discontinued in the mid-1990s; the lookout continues as a communications facility.

notes_for_editor: Unresolved: the second building is dated 1937 (L-4 cabin, register) but the Forest lookouts history says CCC work began in June 1940 and finished in 1941. The sources do not say whether these describe the same building. Access today is not documented; drive_up is inferred only from the Idaho Fire Lookouts 'Drive-In' label and should be checked. The record's kind 'two_story' is not contradicted, but no source uses that term. Elevation is 9,160 ft in the register and 9,151 ft on Idaho Fire Lookouts. A different Bald Mountain Lookout (Nez Perce-Clearwater NF, Recreation.gov 234507, built 1964) appeared in search results and was excluded. Those results are not about this tower.
